digest.component_or_area: LLM capabilities override table (Bedrock and Anthropic adapters)
propositions: The override table lists only us.anthropic.claude-opus-4-7 but rebar's DEFAULT_MODEL is claude-opus-4-8, leaving it unguarded from temperature parameter rejection
Both us.* and global.* Bedrock model prefixes reject temperature and top_p parameters for opus-4-8 and opus-4-7, but the table keys by full id without wildcard matching
The direct Anthropic adapter (anthropic:claude-opus-4-8) silently drops temperature via pydantic-ai but produces log noise, while the Bedrock adapter returns 400 errors when temperature is sent

Code-review Pass-2 pins temperature=0 for determinism but receives no error on sonnet; if it ran on opus-4-8 the parameter would be silently withdrawn without indication that greedy decoding was not achieved
The capability record field name supports_temperature misdescribes the mechanism; the rejection is of parameter tunability (temp=1.0 succeeds, temp=0.0/0.5 fail) not complete unsupport
